purpose.zh: 练托马斯全旋需要的分腿撑起力量
purpose.en: Build the straddle support strength you need for flares.

text.zh: 手臂伸直推地，把屁股和双腿撑离地面
text.en: Lock your arms and push the floor to lift your hips and legs up

text.zh: 宽分腿坐，双手在两腿之间撑地。
text.en: Sit in a wide straddle with your hands on the floor between your legs.

text.zh: 肩膀往下压，身体前倾，撑住别落地。
text.en: Press your shoulders down, lean forward, and stay up.

cautions.zh: 手腕不舒服时先活动一下手腕
cautions.en: If your wrists feel stiff, warm them up first.

cautions.zh: 手腕或肩膀疼时少做一点，还疼就停
cautions.en: If your wrists or shoulders hurt, do less, and stop if it still hurts.

changes: 剂量从计时 10 s 改为按次数 3×4：动画每 8 s 撑起 1.0 s → 停 4.8 s → 坐下 1.0 s → 休 1.2 s
cue3 写明撑住约 5 秒
真实做法是静止保持：改回计时 10 秒×3 组，口令改成进入—保持—呼吸；动画的起落只作示意
最终口径：按真实做法定（2026-11-01）
